results.condition: a carrot lands on a fully mature, free 2x2 and is planted there (origin (19,19) for a landing exactly on its centre)
exactly the 4 footprint tiles are occupied and stay mature; nothing else is occupied
planting does not change greened / mature / target counts, which match a recount
with all four 2x2 blocks valid, the block whose centre is nearest to the landing point is chosen (60 random points)
a landing on a tile centre (four equally near blocks) picks the same block on every fresh run
an isolated mature 2x2 with ANY one tile empty / seed / sprout1 / sprout2 / water / building / occupied refuses planting (no plant, no seeds spent, nothing reserved, occupancy unchanged)
the isolated mature 2x2 with no defect does take a plant (the refusals above are caused by the defect)
when some of the 4 blocks around the landing tile contain a defect, a valid one is planted; none when all 4 do
the fallback choice is identical on repeated identical runs
a landing at the world corner plants on the in-bounds block only (origin (0,0))
a landing outside the map plants nothing and does not crash
